networkCoordinator.title: ZS-EHT-54P2 / 54P7: a coordinator on your home network

photos.alt: ZS-EHT network coordinator in a black case with two antennas and Ethernet
photos.label: ZS-EHT-54P2 / 54P7

networkCoordinator.photos_caption: The seller uses the same image for 54P2 and 54P7. Check the label for the exact revision and chip; the case alone does not identify it.
networkCoordinator.intro: An inexpensive option if you already have a computer for Zigbee2MQTT and want the radio closer to your plants. Its documentation makes it a candidate for GrowerHub's existing Zigbee2MQTT path. We have not tested a physical unit with GrowerHub.
networkCoordinator.requirement: An always-on computer running Zigbee2MQTT is required. The coordinator and an MQTT server address alone are not enough; Home Assistant is optional.
networkCoordinator.path: Start the pilot with a coordinator on your home network and one sensor. We will check fresh readings, history and recovery after a restart. If Zigbee2MQTT already serves your setup, first discuss a local bridge that preserves your network.
networkCoordinator.purchase_note: Already own ZS-EHT? Join a trial connection. If not, discuss the complete kit first: this coordinator does not replace the computer. This is a GrowerHub initiative, without a claimed partnership with the seller.
networkCoordinator.question: Would you like to try your coordinator with GrowerHub, or are you just looking?
networkCoordinator.contact_intro: Let's discuss a trial connection in the GrowerHub channel's direct messages. We will reply there and agree on the next steps together.
networkCoordinator.contact_details: Write 'ZS-EHT pilot', your coordinator model, whether you have a computer running Zigbee2MQTT and which sensor you want to connect. Include a different contact method if you prefer. Do not send passwords or access keys.
networkCoordinator.contact_note: The button opens Telegram. We receive your request only after you send a message. Opening this dialog does not connect or change any devices.

pushok.intro: Connect PushOk to GrowerHub over the internet. You need a hub already set up in Upravlyator, its ID and two short pairing-button presses. No separate computer, Home Assistant or MQTT setup is needed.
pushok.availability: The pilot is available in the app. Cloud pairing, readings, on/off control and reconnection were verified on POK100v2 with firmware 95 and a Zbeacon TS011F plug. Other hubs, sensors and functions need separate checks; we do not claim support for every Zigbee device.

steps.title: Prepare the hub
steps.text: Set up Wi-Fi and pair one sensor or test plug in Upravlyator. Check for fresh readings with your phone using mobile data.

steps.title: Copy the hub ID
steps.text: In Upravlyator, tap the hub name at the top, then the gear beside it. On the hub information screen, copy the hub ID, such as pushok-A1B2C3-1234. Its display name and IP address are different.

steps.title: Connect in GrowerHub
steps.text: Open Settings → Connections → Connect PushOk, paste the ID and confirm device access. Press the hub pairing button twice briefly. While its indicator flashes, press the connection button in GrowerHub.

steps.title: Check the first readings
steps.text: After connection, open Settings → Devices. Add new devices in Upravlyator; GrowerHub refreshes the list automatically. Assign available sensors to a growing area in the farm builder. Automations stay off until you enable them.

pushok.invitation: Already own PushOk? Start with one device and tell us what is missing. For another model or setup help, use “PushOk help and my request” in connection settings. No Wi-Fi password or key export from your phone is needed.
pushok.purchase_note: Connectivity depends on the internet and PushOk’s cloud. GrowerHub automations run on its server and do not run locally on the hub when disconnected. This plug is not approved for automatic watering. If you have no equipment yet, discuss the exact model and intended use first. This is a GrowerHub integration; no manufacturer partnership is claimed.

early_access_text: The main functions of GrowerHub are already available for free and without a card. Connect equipment, assemble zones and customize controls at your own pace. If you need help, the GrowerHub team is nearby on Telegram.

start.title: How to get started with GrowerHub
start.description: Start with GrowerHub: a hardware-free demo farm, Zigbee2MQTT connections or the PushOk cloud pilot without a separate computer.
start.intro: Explore a prepared farm or connect one of your own sensors first. You can start monitoring before adding every plant or configuring automation.

steps.title: Login
steps.text: Use Yandex or Google. No card needed.

steps.title: Select mode
steps.text: Choose whether Zigbee2MQTT is already running or this is a new setup with a USB coordinator.

steps.title: Create a connection
steps.text: Name the coordinator and save your personal configuration. For an existing Zigbee2MQTT installation, the wizard will prepare a local bridge.

steps.title: Run package
steps.text: Select Windows, Raspberry Pi/Linux, or download the configuration for manual installation.

steps.title: See devices
steps.text: GrowerHub automatically shows devices and the metrics exposed by Zigbee2MQTT.

steps.title: Create a zone
steps.text: Specify only the name and distribute the devices. Plants are added as desired.

steps.title: Open dashboard
steps.text: View data and manage permitted functions. Turn on automation later.

paths.title: Try it without equipment
paths.text: Open a prepared demo farm with charts, watering and scenarios. No registration is required.

paths.title: I have PushOk or want a simple hub
paths.text: Connect over the internet using the hub ID and pairing button. Start with one device; no separate computer is needed.

paths.title: Already using Home Assistant / Zigbee2MQTT
paths.text: Keep your Zigbee network and local MQTT. Add the connector and verify one sensor.

paths.title: Start with a USB coordinator on Windows
paths.text: Check the COM port and adapter type, download your personal configuration and start the package.

paths.title: I have a ZS-EHT network coordinator
paths.text: Try a connection together. A separate computer running Zigbee2MQTT is required; Home Assistant is optional.

start.help: Tell us what you grow and which equipment you have. If you have none yet, we can help you choose where to start. If you are already connecting devices, tell us which step you reached.

minimum.title: Minimum setup for Zigbee2MQTT
minimum.monitoring: Always-on computer or Raspberry Pi, supported Zigbee coordinator and one temperature/humidity sensor.
minimum.control: For control, add a Zigbee smart plug. Soil sensors, leak sensors and other equipment can be connected later.
minimum.existing: If Zigbee2MQTT and Home Assistant are already running, the local bridge will leave MQTT in place and transfer only the necessary topics to GrowerHub.
